paper.title: An open-source tool for comparing protein structure predictions

paper_text:
An open-source tool for comparing protein structure predictions
Mensah, K.  J. Fake Bioinformatics, 2020

Abstract
We present StructCompare, an open-source tool that scores the similarity of predicted protein structures.
